document.title: Remotion Code-Only Animation Style Catalogue
document.scope: 49 visual styles: all 13 styles explicitly named by the user plus 36 additional styles

allowed: Procedural geometry and textures written in code
Manually authored SVG, PNG, JPEG, WebP and sprite-sheet assets
disallowed: AI generation APIs or model inference in the production pipeline
policy.important_clarification: Remotion renders frames; it does not automatically create finished character art, rigs, models, textures or animation performances. These must be coded procedurally or authored manually.

core_stack.package_note: Use only packages needed by a selected renderer. Verify package compatibility with the installed Remotion, React, Three.js and Node versions before locking dependencies. Remotion package versions should generally be kept aligned.

rendering_contract.determinism: Every animation value must be derived from the Remotion frame number, composition fps and explicit input props. Avoid uncontrolled randomness, wall-clock time, network fetches during render and non-deterministic browser state.
rendering_contract.frame_model: Use useCurrentFrame() and useVideoConfig() as the source of timeline time; use interpolate(), spring() and Sequence/Series where appropriate.
rendering_contract.3d_model: For Three.js, update scene state from the Remotion frame and render deterministic frames; do not rely on free-running requestAnimationFrame animation.
rendering_contract.asset_policy: All source artwork, models, textures, fonts, sounds and sprite sheets must be manually authored, procedurally generated by code, licensed, or otherwise supplied by the project. No AI-generated assets.
quality_gates: A sample composition renders successfully in headless Chromium
No missing fonts, images, textures or model files
Frame output is deterministic across repeated renders
Character identity and proportions remain consistent across states
Walk and run cycles loop without visible jumps

document.style_selection_rule: A style must not appear as production-ready in a UI dropdown until its renderer, required assets, sample composition and automated render tests pass.

styles.name: Pixel Art

implementation.rendering_approach: Canvas 2D or CSS image-rendered pixel sprites; nearest-neighbor scaling; palette-limited procedural tiles.
implementation.character_creation: Hand-authored pixel sprites or code-drawn pixel grids; sprite atlas for each character.
implementation.animation_methods: Sprite-sheet frame selection by Remotion frame; CSS steps() for preview; Canvas drawImage source rectangles.
implementation.backgrounds_environments: Tilemap, procedural pixel tiles, parallax layers.
implementation.effects_camera_lighting: Nearest-neighbor scaling; palette swaps; pixel particles; screen shake.

styles.asset_requirements: Sprite sheets are authored manually or generated algorithmically; no AI required.

remotion_integration.timeline: Drive all animation from useCurrentFrame() and useVideoConfig(); use interpolate() and spring() for deterministic timing.
remotion_integration.composition: Implement as a reusable React component and register a tested composition through the Remotion project.
remotion_integration.transitions: Use @remotion/transitions when suitable; otherwise implement transitions with CSS, SVG, Canvas or Three.js.
remotion_integration.audio: Use Remotion audio components and frame-based timing where the style requires sound effects or narration.

feasibility.limitations: Keep integer scaling and avoid smoothing; large numbers of individual DOM pixels are inefficient.

styles.name: PS2 Style

implementation.character_creation: Manually modelled low-poly characters; skeletal rigs or rigid-part rigs.
implementation.animation_methods: Three.js AnimationMixer, keyframe transforms, manually authored poses; Remotion drives exact frame/time.
implementation.backgrounds_environments: Three.js meshes, baked or hand-built environments, low-resolution textures.
implementation.effects_camera_lighting: Low-res render target, fog, vertex lighting approximation, dithering, texture filtering controls.

styles.asset_requirements: Requires manually authored 3D models, UVs, textures and rigs; a PS2 look is an emulation, not an actual PS2 renderer.
